1★ Highly disappointed with the service*

We booked them for my brother’s wedding. Engagement was on 24th Dec and the package was around 33k which included photos, cinematic video, and an Instagram reel. We finalized them because their Instagram page looked really good.

The photos were delivered on time, but the editing was very basic – just looked like a filter was added and sent. After continuous follow-up, 2 months after the engagement they provided a poorly edited video and reel. The cinematic video was poorly cut and the quality was very poor. The reel was even worse – completely amateur work, nothing like what they post on their own page.

Worst part is after taking the full 33k upfront, they have been ignoring our calls and WhatsApp messages for the last 4 months. Zero accountability.

We trusted them with our memories and paying 33k for this service was heartbreaking. Don’t go by their social media. Extremely unprofessional team

featured_reviews.review_text:
I got to know about The Wedding Diaries through my wedding planner, and I’m so glad we chose them to capture the most special days of our lives. I had a 3-day destination wedding in Goa, and from start to finish, the experience with the team was nothing short of amazing.

The team was extremely professional, well-coordinated, and super fun to work with. What absolutely blew me away was their speed and quality of delivery – I received my wedding sneak peek photos and teaser video even before I reached back home to Pune! I still remember playing it on our TV right after my Gruhpravesh – all our family members gathered around, watching the video with smiles and happy tears. It was a magical moment, and the way they captured it made it even more special.

The trailer, edited photos, and final films were exactly what I had envisioned – vibrant, emotional, elegant, and full of life. Every frame reflected the joy, laughter, and love we experienced during the wedding. Not only was everything delivered before the promised timeline, but the attention to detail in editing and storytelling was just impeccable.

A big thank you to the entire team at The Wedding Diaries for making our memories last a lifetime in the most beautiful way possible. If you’re looking for a team that is professional, creative, punctual, and passionate about what they do – don’t think twice!

featured_reviews.name: Neharika Mohata
featured_reviews.review_text:
had the pleasure of booking The Wedding Diaries for my wedding, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the very beginning, their team was professional, responsive, and genuinely interested in understanding our vision for the big day.

On the wedding day, they were incredibly well-organized and made us feel completely at ease. They captured every important moment beautifully without ever being intrusive. What really stood out was their attention to detail from candid emotions to the smallest décor elements, everything was documented perfectly.

The final photos and videos exceeded our expectations. The editing was elegant and natural, and every image told a story. Looking through our album truly feels like reliving the entire celebration.

I highly recommend The Wedding Diaries to anyone looking for a talented and reliable wedding photography team. They not only deliver stunning results but also make the entire experience smooth and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Surabhi Harlalka
featured_reviews.review_text:
We couldn’t have asked for a more perfect photography team for our big day than Wedding Diaries! We feel incredibly lucky to have had them capture one of the most important days of our lives.

From the very beginning, their team was so warm, professional, and easy to work with. They made us feel completely comfortable in front of the camera, which honestly made all the difference. Their energy, passion, and attention to detail truly stood out throughout every moment of the celebration.

What we love the most is how every single picture tells a story. It’s not just about beautiful photos (which they absolutely are!), but about the emotions, the candid moments, and the little details that they captured so effortlessly. Looking through our wedding album feels like reliving the entire day all over again—every laugh, every tear, every special glance.

They were quick, well-organized, and incredibly dedicated, making sure no moment was missed while still keeping everything smooth and stress-free for us.

If you’re looking for a photography team that goes beyond just taking pictures and truly captures the essence of your special moments, we wholeheartedly recommend Wedding Diaries. Thank you for giving us memories that we will cherish forever!

featured_reviews.name: Priya Gadkari
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the absolute pleasure of working with our wedding photographer across all six of our wedding functions, and I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the experience. From day one, his professionalism stood out he was always perfectly punctual and consistently arrived on time for every event, which gave us a great sense of comfort and reliability throughout the celebrations.

Managing one function smoothly is impressive, but handling six different events so seamlessly is truly commendable. Each function had its own energy and emotions, yet he adapted effortlessly, capturing every moment with precision and creativity. Despite the busy schedule and back-to-back events, he never seemed rushed and ensured every important moment was beautifully documented.

What I appreciated the most was how natural and comfortable he made everyone feel. Weddings can be overwhelming, especially with multiple functions, but he guided us so calmly that nothing ever felt forced. My entire family was equally impressed—not just with the final photos, but with how politely and professionally he interacted with everyone.

His attention to detail, consistency across all events, and ability to capture genuine emotions made our wedding memories even more special. Each function has its own story, and he captured them all perfectly.

I would wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable, talented, and dedicated wedding photographer especially for multi-event weddings. Thank you for making all six of our functions so memorable!

featured_reviews.name: Ketaki Yelgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:

One of the things that completely blew us away was their super fast delivery of photos and films — all of our event photos were shared with us on the same day! Yes, same day!
